svg.title: Dragonwilds AWS Reference Architecture
svg.desc: Reference architecture for a RuneScape: Dragonwilds dedicated game server on AWS. Depicts allow-listed player ingress, an EC2 Security Group container enclosing the compute workload, EBS persistence, AWS Backup, zero-SSH SSM administration, a hardened AMI with the game server baked in as a Podman Quadlet, CloudWatch logs, metrics, alarms, and dashboard, AWS Budgets and Cost Anomaly Detection for cost alerts, and automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions, Packer, and CloudFormation.
svg.text: RuneScape: Dragonwilds Dedicated Game Server Reference Architecture
OIDC federation · no long-lived AWS keys
